title: Very Low Quality
text:
Very Low Quality. I guess if you were moving into your first apartment or home and your budget was stretched and you didn't want to drive to a Dollar store this. . . maybe would be usable. Kinda. I got the two pack, one's already broken while trying to get recent stains off. The toilet is cleaned weekly so nothing builds up or sticks around and the thread holding the head to the handle on one has not quite fully broken but stretched and bent out of shape.
The receptacle is nice, it keeps the brush up in the air and has a slot to put some sort of, not included, deodorant puck in. Needs to be weighted to keep in place better.
I honestly had higher hopes for these, didn't know they were two part brushes, I've never come across a toilet brush you have to assemble.
